summary: preinstall opens reverse shell to hardcoded IP and beacons to canarytokens URL
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs a bash interactive reverse shell to the hardcoded bare-IP host 147.93.157.202:8080 and pipes output via curl POST to http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php. This fires automatically on `npm install`, giving the remote party interactive shell access on the installer's host and beaconing installation to a third-party tracker. The version number (19999.0.3) is characteristic of dependency-confusion attacks designed to win resolution against a private internal package. Self-labeling as an authorized canary does not change the behavior: the reverse shell provides full-host RCE regardless of stated intent.
